configurations.name: jubjub-web-mock
runtimeArgs: require('child_process').spawn('npx expo start --web --port 8082', { cwd: 'app', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true, env: { ...process.env, EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL: '' } })

configurations.name: jubjub-server-local
runtimeArgs: require('child_process').spawn('.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000', { cwd: 'server', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true, env: { ...process.env, DATABASE_URL: 'sqlite:///./local.db', PYTHONIOENCODING: 'utf-8' } })
